// @molis-ai/molis-work-plugin-sdk/state-machine: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export interface StateMachine<State extends string, Event extends string> {
    can(from: State, event: Event): boolean;
    assert(from: State, event: Event): void;
    next(from: State, event: Event): State;
    family(state: State): StateRingFamily;
    describe(): StateMachineDeclaration<State>;
    apply(port: StateMachinePort<State>, input: {
        readonly expectedFrom: State;
        readonly event: Event;
    }): Promise<State>;
}

export type { StateMachineDeclaration } from "@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/plugin";

export interface StateMachineDefinition<State extends string, Event extends string> extends StateMachineDeclaration<State> {
    readonly transitions: Readonly<Record<Event, StateMachineTransition<State>>>;
    readonly allow_any?: readonly State[];
}

export interface StateMachinePort<State extends string> {
    beforeEffect(): void | Promise<void>;
    compareAndSet(expected: State, next: State): boolean | Promise<boolean>;
}

export interface StateMachineTransition<State extends string> {
    readonly from: readonly State[];
    readonly to: State;
    readonly trigger?: ActionReference;
}

export declare function defineStateMachine<State extends string, Event extends string>(definition: StateMachineDefinition<State, Event>): StateMachine<State, Event>;

export declare function inspectStateMachineDeclarations(value: unknown, pluginId: string): void;

export declare const stateMachineErrors: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/actions").ErrorCodeRaisers<{
    readonly declaration_invalid: "invalid";
    readonly state_unknown: "invalid";
    readonly transition_invalid: "conflict";
    readonly state_changed: "conflict";
}>;
